title: Not for couches with automatic footrests
text: Not for couches with automatic footrests. Beautiful material but it doesn’t work for automatic footrests that raise up.

product_metadata.title: Serta | Faux Leather Non-Slip Waterproof Furniture Protector with Side Pockets & NeverWet, Loveseat, Fawn
features: INCLUDES: (1) Serta faux leather furniture protector

FEATURES: Non-slip Faux Leather fabric face treated with NeverWet ultra-hydrophobic stain repel and release. Superior liquid and stain repel protection for up to 50 washes. Classic, stylish faux leather reverses to soft fleece. Handy pockets on the arms are perfect for remotes and devices. Access points in pockets allow for charging devices.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Wipe clean with damp cloth
DIMENSIONS: Loveseat- Fits most seat widths up to 48” wide x 20” deep, overall 74” h x 48” w + 30” w each arm
description: The Serta Faux Leather Furniture Protector with NeverWet is truly the best way to protect and prolong the life of your furniture. Whether you’re dealing with pets, a favorite couch you’d like to keep around for a few more years, or a furniture set that needs a fabric refresher, faux leather protectors feature NeverWet guaranteed to safeguard your furniture from spills, drips, mishaps, or accidents. The NeverWet technology is super hydrophobic, so liquids effortlessly roll off the surface, keeping your furniture dry and protected. It’s also stain resistant and outperforms other stain repelling treatments on the market. Handy pockets on the arms are perfect for remotes and devices. Access points in pockets allow for charging devices.
